name: Green Quads
description: Engineers have been working hard to create such a unique camouflage. Just like a chameleon, your tank will blend in with its surroundings. However, it won't work properly in deserts and within city limits.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on April 16th, 2020.
This paint could have been unlocked at Tier 45 of the April 2020 Challenge B, or at Tier 23 of the August 2021 Challenge A, both with a Battle Pass.
With update 640, released March 19, 2021, Green Quads received a unique Garage description.
